description: This file implements the DhtGrainLocator class, which is an internal class in the Orleans runtime responsible for locating, registering, and unregistering grains using an in-memory distributed directory. It includes methods for lookup, registration, unregistration, cache management, and a nested class for batched deregistration processing.

classes.name: DhtGrainLocator
classes.description: Implements the IGrainLocator interface using an in-memory distributed directory for Orleans grains.

classes.name: BatchedDeregistrationWorker
classes.description: A nested class within DhtGrainLocator that handles batching and processing of deregistration requests asynchronously.

methods.name: DhtGrainLocator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the locator with local grain directory and grain context.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address with an optional previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address based on the cause, initializing workers if necessary.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Lazily initializes deregistration workers if they are not already initialized.

methods.name: FromLocalGrainDirectory
methods.description: Creates a DhtGrainLocator instance from a local grain directory.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a grain ID and silo address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a grain ID or address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a cached grain address for a given grain ID.
